CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN.description: Claude Code OAuth token (from `claude setup-token`). Injected as env var so the CLI skips the interactive login prompt. Note: Remote Control does not accept this token type.

GH_TOKEN.description: GitHub CLASSIC PAT with `repo`, `workflow`, `read:org`, `user` scopes. gh CLI and git (via the credential helper set in post-create.sh) pick it up automatically - no `gh auth login` needed after rebuilds. Grants cross-repo access for opening PRs on other repos. The `user` scope also powers the Codespace core-hours widget in the statusline (billing usage API; fine-grained tokens are NOT supported there).
